# THE MENU [italic]Kitchens currently delivering to {colony}. Descriptions are written by the kitchens, who are allowed to be vague.[/italic]
## PIZZA GALAXY (4.5 STARS) - [bold]The Supreme[/bold]. Everything. $12. - [bold]The Margherita[/bold]. Tomato, cheese, leaf. The leaf is real. We had it flown in. $9. - [bold]Pineapple[/bold]. We know. We make it anyway. $10.
## TACO BUNKER (4 STARS) - [bold]Beef Taco[/bold]. Contains beef. $3. - [bold]Chicken Taco[/bold]. Contains chicken, according to our supplier. $3. - [bold]Fish Taco[/bold]. The fish is from an orbital farm. The farm would like you to know the fish was happy. $4.
## NOODLE RING (5 STARS) - [bold]Chow Mein[/bold]. Noodles, sauce, vegetables, mystery. $7. - [bold]Late Bowl[/bold]. Whatever is left at the end of the night. It is always good. Nobody knows why. $5.
## GUS'S RATION SHACK (3 STARS) - [bold]Any Menu, Hot[/bold]. A standard ration, heated and served on a plate, by Gus, of YouTape. Gus will tell you the menu number. Do not order menu 19. $6.
## THE BURGER HOLE (2 STARS) - [bold]Burger[/bold]. A burger. $5. - [bold]Mystery Burger[/bold]. It changes every day. The kitchen staff do not decide what is in it. They are not sure who does. $3.
## DONUT DROP (4 STARS) - [bold]Pink Donut, half dozen[/bold]. They survive re-entry better than anything else on this page. Make of that what you will. $6.
